item.text:
<linkedin_post>ChatGPT will provide less detail about past mass attacks under a policy change OpenAI plans to begin rolling out in the coming weeks. The limits apply to all users, regardless of their reason for asking.

The model will restrict reconstructions that include details about weapons and equipment, how they were obtained, and comparisons of harm that could amplify an attacker’s notoriety. OpenAI says people will still be able to ask about the events, their impact on victims and communities, warning signs and prevention.

The policy draws a practical boundary around which details ChatGPT will provide, including information that may be available elsewhere online. Its usefulness will depend on how well the model preserves room for people to learn about violence and its effects while applying those limits.</linkedin_post>
